name: smwgraphics-spooky-forest
title: Spooky Forest
description:
My contest entry for the dark-themed graphics contest. This one didn't place either :(

It has plenty going on, including layer 3. Remove all the suffices from the ExGFX files (bg, fg, l3, an) before inserting them; these just made it easier for me and possibly will also do so for you to remember what goes where.
Great for forest levels as well, with its insanely tall trees.
